residual_risks: This task adds zero new production code -- every C1-C8 component crossed by the thread already existed as sealed retained code or a sealed spike before this task began; the sole new artifact is the integration test itself, matching the backlog's own single expected_file_areas entry exactly.

The Kafka fault-injection drill restarts the self-provisioned, per-test-run isolated broker (its own ocor-spike-0019-<uuid> container), never the shared ocor-bootstrap-kafka-1 container other tasks depend on -- consistent with the lower-blast-radius principle established in OCOR-DEV-0026/0027.

The C4 'projection' receipt is deliberately a bundle of three independent real reads (TypeDB exact-at-commit, Fuseki marking-safe, Qdrant-ranked context assembly) rather than a single mechanism, since the approved architecture assigns projection responsibilities across multiple backend-specific adapters; all three are exercised in the happy-path thread.

C2 (Unified Semantic Gateway) has no dedicated 'receipt' artifact distinct from the identity resolution (ResolutionOutcome) and the sealed NamedQueryRequest/Response contract already exercised by the C4 projection reads -- C2 is the query/identity substrate the other receipts are built on, not a seventh independent receipt kind, matching the acceptance criteria's own six named receipt kinds (canonical, projection, event, causal, agent, action).
